edges.reason: msg.sender triggers callSender which will call back to the caller.
callSender performs a low-level call to msg.sender.
Low-level call returns control to msg.sender enabling reentrancy.
countAndSend invokes attacker.callSender to re-enter the mock.
Any caller can invoke the nonReentrant callback entry point.
callback increments the counter state variable.
callback mutates the _notEntered reentrancy guard flag.
deposit credits balanceOf for msg.sender.
deposit increases balanceOf[msg.sender].
withdraw debits balanceOf for msg.sender.
withdraw reads balanceOf[msg.sender] to validate the amount.
withdraw decrements balanceOf[msg.sender] before sending ETH.
wad parameter is the amount withdrawn.
withdraw transfers ETH to msg.sender.
ETH transfer invokes msg.sender fallback with 2300 gas.
transferFrom reads allowance[src][msg.sender].
transferFrom updates balanceOf for src and dst.
sendValue performs a call{value:} to the recipient.
Value transfer hands control to msg.sender forwarding all gas.
withdraw calls Address.sendValue to pay the role holder.
amount parameter flows into the ETH payout.
msg.sender must hold the withdraw role to call withdraw.
roleId state variable gates access to withdraw.
roles mapping resolves the required membership for withdraw.
_callOptionalReturn performs a low-level token call.
Low-level token call may re-enter the caller contract.
withdrawErc20 routes the transfer through SafeERC20.
msg.sender must hold the withdraw role to call withdrawErc20.
payRegularFees moves collateral with safeTransfer/safeIncreaseAllowance.
collateralPool local derived from _pfc inside payRegularFees.
regularFee local returned by the Store oracle.
latePenalty local paid to msg.sender when non-zero.
lastPaymentTime is compared with the current time to skip duplicate payments.
cumulativeFeeMultiplier is rescaled by paid fees.
_payFinalFees transfers or pulls collateral via SafeERC20.
payRegularFees calls getCurrentTime which depends on block.timestamp.
executeProposal performs a low-level call to the proposal target.
_executeCall uses inline assembly call forwarding all gas.
Assembly call may hand control to an attacker-controlled target.
to parameter selects the low-level call target.
value parameter is forwarded as call value.
data parameter becomes the calldata of the external call.
executeProposal is external payable and callable by anyone.
executeProposal reads proposal transactions and requestTime from storage.
propose pushes a new proposal into the proposals array.
propose requires the caller to hold the Proposer role.
Raw sstore sets proposals length which proposal ids build upon.
createLiquidation pulls final fee collateral via safeTransferFrom.
createLiquidation burns the liquidated synthetic tokens.
sponsor parameter selects the position being liquidated.
Block timestamp is compared against the liquidation deadline.
dispute pulls the dispute bond collateral from the caller.
withdrawLiquidation transfers collateral out to the caller.
liquidationId parameter selects the liquidation to settle.
rawLiquidationCollateral is decremented by the withdrawn amount.
dispute reads liquidation state from the liquidations array.
Caller must be the disputer, liquidator or sponsor of the liquidation.
createLiquidation reads global collateral for position reduction.
createLiquidation pushes a new LiquidationData entry.
upgrade instantiates a new Migrations contract.
new_address parameter is the deployment target of the upgrade.
restricted modifier compares msg.sender with the stored owner.
upgrade calls setCompleted on the newly deployed Migrations.
upgrade reads last_completed_migration to forward it.
upgrade requires msg.sender to equal the stored governor address.
msg.sender is validated against governor before upgrading.
upgrade calls setMigrated on the existing Voting contract.
fallback performs an assembly-level call.
Assembly call targets msg.sender to attempt reentrancy.
Stored txnData is replayed as calldata during the fallback.
hasBeenCalled guard prevents infinite recursive reentrancy.
setTransactionData writes the txnData used for replay.
success local captures the assembly call return status.
migrateTokens mints new tokens to the token holder.
tokenHolder parameter receives the migrated tokens.
getCurrentTime falls back to block.timestamp when no timer is set.
setCurrentTime writes time into the timerAddress contract.
time parameter is the value written by setCurrentTime.
registerContract requires the ContractCreator role from the roles mapping.
signature parameter is consumed by ecrecover inside ECDSA.recover.
createExpiringMultiParty deploys a mintable synthetic token via the factory.
Block timestamp is the value returned by getCurrentTime.
Proposal execution depends on timestamps and oracle request times.
Current time drives regular fee and late penalty computation.
ERC20 collateral transfers to msg.sender can re-enter via a malicious token.

normalization_plan.reason: param.amount is only used by Withdrawable.withdraw and should fold into that core function node.
param.new_address is only used by Migrations.upgrade and should fold into that core function node.
param.sponsor is only used by Liquidatable.createLiquidation and should fold into that core function node.
param.liquidationId is only used by Liquidatable.withdrawLiquidation and should fold into that core function node.
param.tokenHolder is only used by TokenMigrator.migrateTokens and should fold into that core function node.
param.to is only used by Governor._executeCall and should fold into that core function node.
param.value is only used by Governor._executeCall and should fold into that core function node.
param.data is only used by Governor._executeCall and should fold into that core function node.
param.wad is only used by WETH9.withdraw and should fold into that core function node.
param.time is only used by Testable.setCurrentTime and should fold into that core function node.
param.signature is only consumed by the ecrecover unsafe operation and should fold into it.
param.attacker is used to invoke ReentrancyAttack.callSender and should fold into that core function node.
local.func is the selector passed into ReentrancyAttack.callSender and should fold into that core function node.
local.collateralPool is computed and consumed only inside FeePayer.payRegularFees.
local.regularFee is computed and consumed only inside FeePayer.payRegularFees.
local.latePenalty is computed and consumed only inside FeePayer.payRegularFees.
local.upgraded is the Migrations instance created and used solely inside Migrations.upgrade.
local.success is the return flag of the assembly call unsafe operation and should fold into it.
